narrationTexts: tiers.js looks correct. Fix orderTotal to tax the discounted amount, then run tests.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 total, 0 failing.**

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). It taxed the original amount instead of the discounted one, so any order with both a discount and a tax came out wrong.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. No other functions were broken.
